legalNote: This English version is provided for convenience only. The Kazakh and Russian versions are legally binding and have equal force. In case of any discrepancy, the Kazakh and Russian versions prevail.

options.label: Rights go to the business
options.hint: The business gets the full result, the team keeps authorship
options.summary: Rights to the result pass to the business
options.clause: The Team members transfer to the Business the exclusive property rights to the result of the work in full from the moment the last milestone is confirmed. The Team members retain the personal non-property rights of authors, including the right to be named as authors.

options.label: Rights stay with the team, the business gets a license
options.hint: The team can keep developing the result, the business uses it for free
options.summary: Rights stay with the team, the business gets a license
options.clause: The exclusive property rights to the result of the work remain with the Team members. The Team grants the Business a free non-exclusive license to use the result for the Business's internal needs without limitation of term or territory.

options.label: Joint rights
options.hint: Both parties use the result, rights can be sold only together
options.summary: Rights to the result are joint
options.clause: The exclusive property rights to the result of the work belong jointly to the Business and the Team members. Each party may use the result for its own needs. Rights may be transferred to third parties only with the consent of both parties.

options.label: Can be shown
options.hint: The best option for students and for the business's reputation
options.summary: The result can be shown in a portfolio
options.clause: The Team may show the result and the project description in portfolios and at educational events without disclosing confidential information of the Business.

options.label: After approval
options.hint: The business sees in advance what will be shown
options.summary: Portfolio use after approval by the business
options.clause: The Team may show the result in a portfolio only after written approval of the Business. The Business responds to a request within 5 working days.

options.label: Without the company name
options.hint: The result can be shown, the business name is hidden
options.summary: Portfolio use without the company name
options.clause: The Team may show the result in a portfolio without naming the Business and without its data.

options.label: Not allowed
options.hint: The team may mention only the fact of participation
options.summary: The result cannot be shown in a portfolio
options.clause: The Team may not show the result to third parties. The Team may mention in its portfolio only the fact of participation in the project.

options.label: Open information
options.hint: Suitable for educational tasks without secrets
options.summary: Task information is open
options.clause: Information on the task is not confidential, except for personal data.

options.label: Basic
options.hint: Non-public information is not disclosed for 1 year
options.summary: Basic confidentiality, 1 year
options.clause: The Team does not disclose to third parties any non-public information of the Business received during the work for 1 year after the work ends.

options.label: Strict, NDA
options.summary: NDA regime for trade secrets, 3 years
options.clause: Information that the Business has marked as a trade secret is used by the Team only for work on the task and is not disclosed for 3 years after the work ends. Only the Team members who have confirmed this agreement get access to it.

options.label: Synthetic
options.hint: The fastest start with no risks
options.summary: The team works with synthetic data
options.clause: The Business provides the Team only with synthetic data created for the work on the task.

options.label: Depersonalized
options.summary: The team works with depersonalized data
options.clause: The Business provides the Team with data depersonalized before transfer. The Team makes no attempts to re-identify the data subjects.

options.label: Real, under a separate agreement
options.summary: Real data under a separate agreement
options.clause: Real data, including personal data, is provided to the Team only where a legal basis exists and under a separate agreement of the parties that defines the purposes, the processing periods and the protection measures.

options.label: 2 working days
options.summary: Replies to proposals within 2 working days
options.clause: The Business reviews proposals and communicates its decision within 2 working days.

options.label: 3 working days
options.summary: Replies to proposals within 3 working days
options.clause: The Business reviews proposals and communicates its decision within 3 working days.

options.label: 5 working days
options.summary: Replies to proposals within 5 working days
options.clause: The Business reviews proposals and communicates its decision within 5 working days.

options.label: 7 working days
options.summary: Replies to proposals within 7 working days
options.clause: The Business reviews proposals and communicates its decision within 7 working days.

options.label: Weekly call
options.summary: Weekly call with the contact person
options.clause: The parties hold an online call once a week. Between calls, questions are resolved in a work chat.

options.label: Work chat
options.summary: Consultations in a work chat
options.clause: Consultations take place in a work chat. The contact person of the Business answers questions within 1 working day.

options.label: Email
options.summary: Consultations by email
options.clause: Consultations take place by email. The contact person of the Business replies within 2 working days.

options.label: Office meetings
options.summary: Meetings at the business's office
options.clause: The parties meet at the office of the Business on an agreed schedule. Interim questions are resolved in a work chat.

options.label: Educational project
options.summary: Educational project without payment
options.clause: The work is performed for educational purposes without remuneration unless the parties agree otherwise.

options.label: Internship afterwards
options.summary: The best members will be offered an internship
options.clause: Following the work, the Business considers inviting Team members to an internship. The invitation is not an obligation of the Business.

options.label: Payment
options.summary: Payment by agreement
options.clause: The Business pays the Team remuneration of {{rewardAmount}} after the last milestone is confirmed, under a separate contract.
